says: The closed vocabularies of the holon declaration, version 0. A declaration that uses a word not listed here is refused (vocabulary_unregistered). Words are added here, with a dated note in standard/HOLON-DECL.md, and nowhere else.

status.simulated: Computed by a named engine: a file of the declaring repository (step.engine), or an engine held elsewhere (step.engine_external), in which case the answer is pending. Owes: step.kind computed, with an engine.
status.measured: A result of the declaring repository, read from its record. Owes: a source, and a certificate whose evidence carries a sha256.
status.catalogue: A value published elsewhere, used at its published size. Owes: a source.
status.declared: An input taken as given; nothing here derives it. Owes: a source.
status.wager: A chosen position that could be wrong. Owes: a kill with the date it was stated.
status.illustration: A picture; nothing computes it. Owes: no certificate (one is refused), and a draw view with a label.
status.proved: The CODE that computes the view is proved by a proof assistant, not only its specification. Owes: evidence that includes a check run. Where only the definition is proved and the code agrees with it on cases, the view is case_checked and says so in `specification`.
status.model_checked: Every state of a stated finite model was explored. Owes: evidence that includes a check run.
status.case_checked: Agreement with a reference over a stated set of cases. Owes: evidence that includes a check run.
status.unchecked: Nothing checks it. Said so that a view among checked ones is not taken for one of them.

standing.tier: A closed view that a consumer carries (OBJECT.md, the corrections of 2026-09-25 and 2026-11-15; TIERS.md section 0: both are measured). Owes TWO things: a closure certificate, and a price that reads carried for the consumer named in carried_by. It also says whether its budget window was measured.
standing.sector: A closed view that the consumers it was tested against do not carry. Owes TWO things: a closure certificate, and a price that reads dropped for a consumer listed in tested_against.
standing.rung: A scale shown or used with no closure claim.
standing.input: Taken from outside the ladder: a declared or catalogue value.
standing.medium: Something others are seen through or conditioned on: the air, a mask, a light. Owes: at least one view.
standing.recorded: a row of this repository's own ladder, declared as the record words it. It owes `row`, a quotation of that row which must occur in the file, and, when measured, a record cited with the words it rests on. Whatever certificate the row has is in the record; this format checks none for it
standing.function: A pure function of what it is given: it has no state of its own and no step in time. Owes: step.kind computed. No closure claim is implied.

step.computed: Its state is computed by an engine named in step.engine (or engine_external). It may or may not change in time.
step.static: It is given as it stands, and nothing computes it.
step.generated: Built by rule from a seed. It has no dynamics: any motion shown is animation, not a step.
step.measured: Its motion is read from a record, not computed here.
step.declared: Its motion is given from outside.

relation.function: This holon's reading is a function of the one below. Owes: a basis, a file of the repository that shows it.
relation.shared_edge: The two are built to show the same thing in the same place where they meet. Owes: a basis, a file of the repository that says so.
relation.theory_change: The one below is a different theory. A cross-fade would show frames that are states of neither.
relation.context: The one below is context only: nothing here is derived from it.

consumer.renderer: Reads the view at a screen's acuity. Its budget is in px (position) or level (one step of an 8-bit display channel).
consumer.tier_above: A declared holon that stands on this one and reads the view as its state. Owes: holon, its id.
consumer.law: A conservation law or other stated invariant. Owes: stated, a file of the repository where the law is written.
consumer.person: A reader of a screen: the view must be legible, not only drawn.
consumer.verifier: A second party recomputing the claim from the same inputs.
consumer.dependent: A component built on this one at a pinned version. Owes: pin, the version or tag it pins.
consumer.target: The stated quantity a gate, a stake or a search was read against (a block's own next state; an increment beyond a named baseline). Not a law. Owes: stated, a file of the repository where the target is written.

certificate.closure: The commuting square v o T = h o v for the named consumer, exactly or within its bound (lean/CIRISHolon/Object.lean, Tier.lean; the statistical form in StatClosure.lean).
certificate.scene: For a generated holon: an exact section law, and a transport cost against a frozen reference sample (lean/CIRISHolon/SceneCert.lean; OBJECT.md, 'The scene certificate').
certificate.bound: A stated bound on the named consumer's error.
certificate.none: No certificate. Required for an illustration.

basis.price: The bound is an a-priori price: what the method says the defect is at most (OBJECT.md, correction of 2026-11-15, item 3).
basis.realised: The bound is a realised cost: what was measured on the run cited.

join.fade: A cross-fade across the boundary. Refused across a theory_change; across context it must say what is owed.

answer.holds: Every check held and everything cited is held here. It says the checks held over the files read; it does not say the evidence supports the claim.
answer.pending: Every check held, but something cited is not held here, or it stands on a declaration that is pending. Never counted as holds.
answer.fails: One or more checks failed. The reason is the sorted set of their tokens.

window.not_measured: the range of budgets over which the carried set does not change has not been measured

reason.member_missing: A. A required member is absent.
reason.member_unexpected: A. A member this version does not define, at any depth.
reason.type_wrong: A. A member has the wrong type or form: an empty string, a negative or non-finite bound, a list too short, a malformed sha256 or date.
reason.id_malformed: A. An id is not lower-case words joined by full stops.
reason.vocabulary_unregistered: A. A word from a closed vocabulary is not in it.
reason.id_duplicate: B. Two declarations carry one id.
reason.below_unresolved: B. below names an id no declaration carries.
reason.below_cycle: B. Following below (and depicts) returns to the same holon.
reason.below_fails: B. It stands on a declaration that is failing.
reason.relation_unbacked: B. A function or shared_edge relation cites no file of the repository as its basis.
reason.depicts_unresolved: B. depicts names an id no declaration carries.
reason.source_missing: B. A declared, catalogue or measured holon, or such a part, cites no source.
reason.source_not_found: B. A source names a path that is not a file of the repository.
reason.kill_missing: B. A wager states no dated kill.
reason.simulated_not_computed: B. status is simulated and step.kind is not computed.
reason.engine_missing: B. A computed step does not name exactly one engine (a file of the repository, or an external one); or another kind of step names one.
reason.medium_without_view: B. standing is medium and no view is declared.
reason.view_without_consumer: B. A view names no consumer.
reason.consumer_conflict: B. One consumer id has two kinds in two views.
reason.consumer_unresolved: B. A tier_above consumer names no declared holon standing on this one; or a law consumer cites no file where the law is stated.
reason.consumer_without_budget: B. The consumer a certificate is for states no budget.
reason.budget_unit_mismatch: B. A renderer's budget is in neither px nor level.
reason.certificate_owed: B. status is measured and certificate.kind is none.
reason.certificate_unbound: B. A certificate does not name a view and consumer of this holon, its bound, and whether that is a price or a realised cost; or kind is none and it carries those members.
reason.certificate_exceeds_budget: B. The certificate's bound is in another unit than the consumer's budget, or looser than it.
reason.illustration_certified: B. status is illustration and certificate.kind is not none.
reason.illustration_undrawn: B. status is illustration and there is no draw view, so no label says it is one.
reason.scene_not_generated: B. A scene certificate on a holon that is not generated; or a generated holon with a closure or bound certificate.
reason.scene_certificate_incomplete: B. A scene certificate lacks its section law, its transport cost, or the frozen reference sample.
reason.evidence_missing: B. A certificate names no evidence.
reason.evidence_not_found: B. Evidence names a path that is not a file of the repository (absolute paths, '..' and directories are not).
reason.evidence_digest: B. Evidence carries a sha256 that is not the file's.
reason.evidence_undigested: B. A measured holon cites a file as evidence with no sha256.
reason.gate_not_found: B. Evidence names a gate that engine/ci-gates.sh does not contain.
reason.regime_missing: B. A certificate with no regime.
reason.tier_uncertified: B. A tier or a sector whose certificate is not a closure certificate.
reason.tier_uncarried: B. A tier's carried_by is not a consumer of its views, or is not the consumer its price is for.
reason.carried_not_tier: B. carried_by on a holon that is not a tier.
reason.sector_untested: B. A sector does not list the consumers it was tested against; or another standing lists them.
reason.fade_across_theories: B. draw joins below by fade across a theory_change.
reason.fade_unbacked: B. draw joins below by fade across a context relation and fade_owed does not say what would make that honest.
reason.join_disagrees: B. Two declarations describe one boundary differently.
reason.ladder_disagrees: B (with --ladder). A declaration that names a rung differs from the engine in name, status, label, unit, marks, band or joins; two declarations claim one rung; or the engine draws a rung no declaration carries.
reason.quote_not_found: a reference quotes words that its file does not contain
reason.row_missing: a recorded row quotes no row of the record
reason.price_contradicts_standing: B. A price says carried or dropped and its numbers read the other; or a tier's price reads dropped, a sector's carried; or a price sits on a standing other than tier, sector or recorded.
reason.check_unbacked: B. A view (or a holon with no per-view status) is proved, model_checked or case_checked and carries no evidence that is a check run.
reason.function_not_computed: B. standing function with a step that is not computed.
reason.plants_miscounted: B. A plant record says more were caught than were planted.
reason.price_missing: B. A tier or a sector with no price.
reason.price_unbound: B. A price names no view and consumer of this holon with a bounded budget in the price's unit.
reason.budget_outside_window: B. The budget a price is read against is not inside the declared budget_window.
reason.tier_window_unstated: B. A tier with no budget_window: neither a window nor the word not_measured.
reason.quote_fragment: B. A quotation is shorter than 30 characters, or starts or ends inside a word of the file.
reason.source_not_record: B. A measured recorded row cites, with words, only the file its row is quoted from.
reason.self_cited: B. A declaration of the register cites the register or the known answers' fixtures.
reason.bound_negative: B. A certificate's bound is below zero.
reason.specification_unbacked: B. A view's specification is not proved or model_checked, or carries no check run as evidence.

reason_needs._: What a party must hold to run the check. blob: the declaration alone. set: the declarations it names. repository: the declarer's files, so on the wire it is the declarer's attestation and not a verified fact, until the file travels by digest.

price_reading.carried: The price, less two of its standard errors, is above the consumer's budget, and no null reaches the budget.
price_reading.dropped: Anything else: a price at the budget, or within two standard errors above it, reads dropped.
